figurative_meaning_en: A desolate place devoid of human presence, resembling a cremation ground
example_sentences_in_bangla: যুদ্ধের পর গ্রামটি শ্মশানপুরী হয়ে গেছে।
শহরের এই অংশটি এখন শ্মশানপুরী সদৃশ নির্জন।
example_sentences_in_english: After the war, the village turned into a cremation ground city.
This part of the city is now a desolate cremation ground-like emptiness.
note: The idiom evokes imagery from Hindu cremation practices, common in Bengali folklore.
